notes.title: FREE DUROV - NEW UPDATE AND DISCOUNT!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello folks! Two news. [/b]

First, the game released a large-scale update, in which [b]47 new memes[/b] were added for players from all over the world.

Second news - hurry up to grab the game at a [b]20% discount![/b]

We have been closely listening to your feedback and have done everything to fix the bugs and improve the gameplay experience. What has changed?

- Fixed UI bugs
- Improved graphics
- Enhanced textures in the second location

notes.title: DEV DIARY — Update 1.3.0 (Demo)
notes.notes:
[b]What's up![/b]

We have been closely listening to your feedback and have done everything to fix the bugs and improve the gameplay experience. Your feedback is very important to us, and thanks to it, we have made many valuable changes. In this update, we focused on optimization, added new features, and fixed issues that may have affected your impression of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45213383/e38e1f77e81e8256682af9d1f2db13017736d296.png[/img]

- [b]New settings in the main menu: music, sound, graphics, screen resolution.[/b]
- Scene optimization: unnecessary objects have been removed.
- Fixed bug with the radio: no more silence after the last sound in the array.
- Fixed bug with the bath: when the character was standing in the bath but not sitting, incorrect mission progress was displayed.
- Added a new loading screen.
- Added a loading screen at the start of the game.
- Music added to the main menu.
- Ice cubes now have textures.
- New task with dumbbells/
- Realistic 3D bath sound added, including water draining sound.
- Ventilation sound added for a more immersive atmosphere.
- Updated link to our Discord server.
- Mentions of new media have been added to the TV.

If you still find any bugs or have ideas for improving the game, feel free to write to us by email: [b]raskumarteam@gmail.com[/b]
